fixes.explanation: True, and I LOVE how plain it is. The LORD lays out His law and His justice as a light to the nations. Then He says, “I will bring it about quickly.” No small print, no "terms and conditions apply." Just a promise, friend, and He means it.

Forgetting Him? Friend, that would be a plot twist, and this verse doesn't have one. The islands “…will look for Me and wait in hope for My arm.” That's far-off places with their eyes on the horizon, not wandering off. I think they're the folks who check the window every five minutes for good news.
